name: Shako VM
description: A new Shako VM for this workspace, deleted with it. The VM clones the repo itself, with no token from this computer: a private repo needs Git access on your VM orca-base, and the recipe prints the one command that gives it. A copy of orca-base when you have one (its agents stay logged in), else a small VM with Claude Code and Codex. It sleeps when idle.
create:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
url="${ORCA_REPO_URL:-$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null)}"
[ -n "$url" ] || { echo "shako: this repository has no remote. Push it to GitHub or another Git host, then create the workspace again." >&2; exit 1; }
repo="$(basename "${url%.git}")"; repo="${repo##*:}"
root="/home/shako/$(printf %s "${repo:-project}" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '-')"
[ "${ORCA_RECIPE_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION:-2}" = 2 ] || { echo "shako: Orca asks for result schema $ORCA_RECIPE_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION; this recipe gives 2" >&2; exit 1; }
head="${ORCA_REPO_REF_HEAD:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
branch="${ORCA_REPO_BRANCH:-$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo main)}"
ref="${ORCA_REPO_REF:-}"
# The VM clones over HTTPS with only the Git access the VM has itself: this recipe reads no token and forwards no
# SSH agent. A public repository needs none; a private one needs Git access on orca-base, which the person gives.
case "$url" in
  git@*:*) src="https://$(printf %s "${url#git@}" | sed 's|:|/|')" ;;
  ssh://git@*) src="https://$(printf %s "${url#ssh://git@}" | sed 's|^\([^/]*\):[0-9]*/|\1/|')" ;;
  *) src="$url" ;;
esac
githost=$(printf %s "$src" | sed 's|^[a-z]*://||; s|^[^@/]*@||; s|[:/].*||')
if ! shako vm info "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if shako vm info orca-base >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    shako vm cp orca-base "$name" >&2 || exit 1
  else
    shako vm create "$name" --agent claude,codex >&2 || exit 1
  fi
fi
shako vm wake "$name" >&2 || exit 1
host=$(shako vm info "$name" | awk '$1 == "ssh" { print $2; exit }')
[ -n "$host" ] || { echo "shako: no SSH name for $name" >&2; exit 1; }
q() { printf "'%s'" "$(printf %s "$1" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g")"; }
script=$(cat <<'REMOTE'
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
if [ ! -d "$root/.git" ]; then
  echo "shako: cloning $src into $root on the VM" >&2
  git clone -q --no-checkout "$src" "$root" || exit 3
fi
git -C "$root" remote set-url origin "$src" 2>/dev/null || git -C "$root" remote add origin "$src"
git -C "$root" cat-file -e "$head^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git -C "$root" fetch -q origin $ref 2>/dev/null || true
git -C "$root" cat-file -e "$head^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git -C "$root" fetch -q origin "$head" 2>/dev/null || true
git -C "$root" cat-file -e "$head^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || exit 4
git -C "$root" checkout -q -f -B "$branch" "$head"
REMOTE
)
vars="root=$(q "$root") src=$(q "$src") head=$(q "$head") branch=$(q "$branch") ref=$(q "$ref")"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$host" "sh -c $(q "$vars
$script")" </dev/null >&2
rc=$?
if [ "$rc" = 3 ]; then
  base="orca-base.${host#*.}"
  echo "shako: the VM could not clone $src. For a private repository, give your VM orca-base Git access once (each workspace VM is a copy of it), then create the workspace again:" >&2
  shako vm info orca-base >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "  shako vm create orca-base --agent claude,codex" >&2
  if [ "$githost" = github.com ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "  gh auth token | ssh $base 'umask 077 && git config --global credential.helper store && printf \"protocol=https\\nhost=github.com\\nusername=x-access-token\\npassword=%s\\n\\n\" \"\$(cat)\" | git credential approve'" >&2
  else
    echo "  On $base, store a Git credential for $githost: git config --global credential.helper store, then git credential approve." >&2
  fi
  exit 3
fi
[ "$rc" = 4 ] && { echo "shako: the start commit $head is not on the Git host. Push it, then create the workspace again." >&2; exit 4; }
[ "$rc" = 0 ] || exit 1
printf '{"schemaVersion":2,"checkoutMode":"provisioned-root","connection":{"type":"ssh","projectRoot":"%s","target":{"label":"%s","host":"%s","port":22,"username":"shako"}},"userData":{"provider":"shako","vm":"%s"}}\n' "$root" "$name" "$host" "$name"
suspend:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
shako vm sleep "$name" >&2 || ! shako vm info "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1
resume:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
url="${ORCA_REPO_URL:-$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null)}"
[ -n "$url" ] || { echo "shako: this repository has no remote. Push it to GitHub or another Git host, then create the workspace again." >&2; exit 1; }
repo="$(basename "${url%.git}")"; repo="${repo##*:}"
root="/home/shako/$(printf %s "${repo:-project}" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '-')"
shako vm wake "$name" >&2 || exit 1
host=$(shako vm info "$name" | awk '$1 == "ssh" { print $2; exit }')
[ -n "$host" ] || { echo "shako: no SSH name for $name" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '{"schemaVersion":2,"checkoutMode":"provisioned-root","connection":{"type":"ssh","projectRoot":"%s","target":{"label":"%s","host":"%s","port":22,"username":"shako"}},"userData":{"provider":"shako","vm":"%s"}}\n' "$root" "$name" "$host" "$name"
destroy:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
shako vm rm "$name" --yes >&2 || ! shako vm info "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1
